Policies

Sample policy content for a clear, transparent customer experience.

SAMPLE CONTENT — NOT AN ACTIVE POLICY

These draft examples demonstrate the intended policy structure. They require review and approval before being adopted or relied on.

Privacy & enquiriesCookies & analyticsService termsOwnership & materials
SAMPLE / 01

Privacy & enquiries

An enquiry may include your name, email address, chosen service, and project details. The sample purpose for using this information is to respond to your request and discuss a potential engagement.

The website’s enquiry form prepares an email draft in your email application. Review its contents before sending. Avoid including passwords, confidential records, or unnecessary personal information.

SAMPLE / 02

Cookies & analytics

A final cookie policy should identify the technologies actually used, their purposes, and any available choices. It should distinguish essential functionality from optional analytics or advertising.

This sample does not confirm that tracking or advertising tools are installed. Any adopted notice should match the live website configuration.

SAMPLE / 03

Service terms

A project proposal should define deliverables, milestones, fees, responsibilities, and acceptance criteria. Changes to scope, third-party costs, and ongoing support should be agreed before the relevant work begins.

Product availability, onboarding, and support arrangements should be confirmed for the specific product or engagement. This sample does not establish commercial terms.

SAMPLE / 04

Ownership & materials

Project agreements should explain ownership and permitted use of deliverables, customer-supplied materials, and third-party components. Account access, source-code handover, and licensing expectations should be discussed explicitly.

Customers and Nexvorx should confirm that materials shared for a project can be used for the intended purpose.

Have a policy question?

Contact Nexvorx to discuss privacy, data handling, or the terms relevant to your enquiry.
